disease_state.evidence: inferred: We performed a comparative phosphoproteomic analysis of Arabidopsis root membrane proteins of WT and nrt1.1-1 under low nitrate (LN) and high nitrate (HN) availability in order to identify the downstream components that may be involved in NRT1.1-dependent LR growth and signal transduction.

material_type.evidence: A total of 1 g of roots (fresh weight) was homogenized in 10 ml extraction buffer (330mM mannitol, 100 mM KCl, 1 mM EDTA, 50 mM Tris-MES, fresh 5 mM DTT, and 1 mM phenylmethylsulfonylfluoride, pH 7.5) in the presence of 0.5% v/v proteinase inhibitor mixture (MedChemExpress) and phosphatase inhibitors (25 mM NaF, 1 mM Na3VO4, 1 mM benzamidin, 3 µM leupeptin) in Dounce homogenizers.
